content_sections.heading: ICMR-NITHR Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Indian Council of Medical Research - National Institute for Tribal Health Research (ICMR-NITHR), Jabalpur, under the Department of Health Research, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India, has released the ICMR-NITHR Recruitment 2026 notification for the recruitment of Project Research Scientist, Project Administrative Officer, Project Field Officer, Project Technical Support, Senior Project Assistant, Project Assistant Multipurpose and Project MTS posts. A total of 25 vacancies across 22 contractual posts have been announced through walk-in interviews scheduled on 05 and 06 October 2026. content_sections.heading: ICMR NITHR Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is made through a walk-in interview conducted by the selection committee at ICMR NITHR, Jabalpur. Only eligible candidates as per essential qualification and age criteria will be allowed to appear. Candidates must carry the duly filled application form with original and photocopies of certificates. Late, delayed, or incomplete applications will be summarily rejected without intimation. Meeting the essential qualification does not guarantee selection. Selected candidates must produce original documents before joining; if found ineligible, selection will be cancelled immediately.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICMR NITHR Recruitment 2026 (Walk-in Interview)
content_sections.text: Download the application format from www.nirth.res.in or www.main.icmr.nic.in. Fill the application form completely with full address, PIN code, mobile number, and email ID. Attach self-attested copies of certificates (qualification, age proof, experience, category certificate). Provide details of two responsible references from your locality. Report to ICMR NITHR, Nagpur Road, Post Garha, Jabalpur, on the applicable interview date, between 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM. Submit the filled application with documents at the venue; no entry after 11:00 AM. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview or joining.

content_sections.heading: Important Terms & Conditions
content_sections.text: All posts are purely temporary and co-terminable with the respective project. Age is reckoned from the date of the walk-in interview. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC is as per DoPT/Government of India norms; no relaxation for unreserved posts. Persons already in regular time-scale government service are not eligible. Preference is given to local candidates and those with higher qualifications/experience. The number of vacancies may vary at a later stage. Any addendum/corrigendum will be published only on www.nirth.res.in.

faq.question: Q1. What is ICMR-NITHR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A recruitment drive by ICMR-National Institute for Tribal Health Research, Jabalpur, under Advt. No. 05/2026-27, for 25 vacancies across 22 temporary/contractual posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: There is no online application deadline; this is a walk-in interview recruitment held on 05-10-2026 (Posts 1–10) and 06-10-2026 (Posts 11–22).

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post, from 10th pass with a diploma to MBBS/PG degree/PhD.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Age limit varies from 27 to 45 years depending on the post, with relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Download the application form from www.nirth.res.in or www.main.icmr.nic.in, fill it, and attend the walk-in interview with documents on the applicable date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is through a walk-in interview based on essential qualification, desirable qualification, and experience for each post.
